entry.title: Development :: RE: [AI] New programming language MasterBASIC
entry.dc:creator: Materion
entry.dc:subject: Development
entry.content:
Author: Materion
Posted: Tue Nov 10, 2026 6:55 am (GMT 0)

I completely agree - hand coded game can be good or bad - same goes for AI coded stuff. It's not a matter if it's hand made or AI made but the effort the creator of game puts into the game/port. Of course I understand competition - it's different matter but for normal posts why not? I will hand code my game and use hand made graphics/music/sound but if someone go AI route and make a good, quality game why stigmatize it?

Back to MasterBASIC - if someone have a suggestion what to add, what to change etc. feel free to post it here :). I started to code my medieval vertical shoot em up game in MasterBASIC and so far it's kinda pleasant experience :).
